identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase Ⅱ Clinical Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Human BCMA Targeted T Cells Injection Therapy for Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma

collaborators.name: First Affiliated Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
A Phase Ⅱ Clinical Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Human BCMA Targeted T Cells Injection（BCMA CAR-T） Therapy for R/R MM.

Patients will be given a conditioning chemotherapy regimen of fludarabine and cyclophosphamide followed by a single infusion of BCMA CAR+ T cells.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Participants with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma can participate if all eligibility criteria are met. Tests required to determine eligibility include disease assessments, a physical exam, Electrocardiograph, Computedtomography （CT）/Magnetic Resonance Imaging(MRI)/Positron Emission Tomography（PET）, and blood draws. Participants receive chemotherapy prior to the infusion of BCMA CAR+ T cells. After the infusion, participants will be followed for side effects and effect of BCMA CAR+ T cells. Study procedures may be performed while hospitalized.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Objective Response Rate (ORR) at 3 months post infusion as evaluated by the Independent Review Committee
primaryOutcomes.description: ORR at 3 months post infusion as evaluated by the Independent Review Committee (IRC) includes stringent complete response (sCR), complete response (CR), very good partial response (VGPR), and partial response (PR).

secondaryOutcomes.description: DOR refers to the time from the first assessment of the tumor for complete response and above efficacy to the first assessment of disease progression or death of any cause;
PFS refers to the time from the start of cell infusion to the first assessment of tumor progression or death from any cause;
OS refers to the time from cell infusion to death due to any cause;

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Objective Response Rate (ORR) at 3 months post infusion as evaluated by the Investigator
secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR at 3 months post infusion as evaluated by the Investigator;

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Objective Response Rate (ORR) at 6 months post infusion as evaluated by the Independent Review Committee
secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR at 6 months post infusion as evaluated by the Independent Review Committee (IRC)；

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of Subjects With Negative Minimal Residual Disease (MRD)
secondaryOutcomes.description: MRD negative rate is defined as the proportion of subjects who achieve MRD negative status;

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Duration of Subjects With Negative Minimal Residual Disease (MRD)
secondaryOutcomes.description: MRD duration will calculated among MRD negative responders fom the date of initial MRD negative to the date of first documented evidence of MRD positive, as defined in the International Myeloma Working Group（IMWG） criteria (2016);

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Subjects with Adverse Events
secondaryOutcomes.description: Adverse event is any untoward medical event that occurs in a subject administered an investigational drug.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change from Baseline in Perform Status as Measured by Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group（ECOG）Score（0-2）
secondaryOutcomes.description: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group（ECOG） Performance Status Score（0-2） will be assessed by the inverstigator at baseline and the respective time point, higher scores mean a worse performance status.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The occurrence rate of adverse events grade ≥ 3 assessed by Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Version 5.0.

Pharmacodynamic indicators: the concentration level of CAR-T cell-related serum cytokines such as Interleukin-6（IL-6）, IL-2, IL-10, Tumor Necrosis Factor （TNF-α），Interferon-γ（IFN-γ）in peripheral blood；
